newsitem.title: USA: ERD Waste names N. James Triaca CFO.
newsitem.headline: ERD Waste names N. James Triaca CFO.

text.p: ERD Waste Corp said on Wednesday that it named N. James Triaca its chief financial officer.
Triaca replaces Kenneth Weiner, who left the company to pursue other business interests.
ERD also said it is moving its corporate headquarters from Rahway to Chicago, reflecting the company's new focus on business in the Midwest. ERD hopes to have the move completed by Labor Day.
ERD is a waste management company.
